description: Land Acquisition - Henepola, Kehelwatthena, Wegollemada and Wadakada, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of multiple land lots for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels including lot numbers, land names, uses, claimants, and extents. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
